entities.summary: Michael James Boddicker is an American former professional baseball right-handed pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Baltimore Orioles (1980–1988), Boston Red Sox (1988–1990), Kansas City Royals (1991–1992), and Milwaukee Brewers (1993). He was the ALCS MVP in 1983 and was an American League All-Star in 1984.
